Where does a self-driving AI fail?
Finding blind spots inside a driving AI’s own activations
Jason He · Hiram Lannes · Christopher Vu · Catherine Wang · Jerry Yan · Mentor: Ryan Lingo, Honda Research Institute

Background
Which data should we collect next?

Results · discovery methods

Conclusions
What it means
  • Activations find one failure type: a visible camera patch
  • Fail2Drive: 28 unseen routes fail, 4 the other way; baseline B3 wins
  • Next: blind test pool
